title: trichera × sambucifolia
intro: Trichera × sambucifolia, commonly known as the hybrid of Trichera and Sambucus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Adoxaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing stress, improving sleep, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
